currentParagraphText: “There really isn’t anything you can offer, no,” Jake shook his head and sighed. “My mind is set. However, I don’t think this meeting is a waste of time, even with that being the case. One thing you said I do fully agree with is that it would be nice for us to leave on good terms today. To leave without unnecessary bloodshed.”
